ruleDefinitions.name: Detected Windows Software Discovery - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may attempt to enumerate software for a variety of reasons, such as figuring out what security measures are present or if the compromised system has a version of software that is vulnerable. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*get\\-itemProperty.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\\software\\\\.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*select\\-object.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*format\\-table.*"))
